title: IAL
line: A Success Stories page with search and filters.
problem: The Institute for Adult Learning (IAL), an autonomous institute under SUSS, focuses on professionalizing adult education through training, research, innovation and lifelong learning initiatives. Visitors needed an easier way to browse IAL's success stories.
did: As a Full-stack Developer, I collaborated with the project manager to build a Success Stories page with search and filtering features. Using C# and Kentico CMS, I retrieved and structured the page data, implemented category and year filters and optimized the Razor views to ensure consistent card layouts.
outcome: Visitors can now find the success stories that matter to them in just a few clicks.
